urls.title: Documentation URLs
urls.description: Public HTTP(S) document URLs. Use consistent seed URLs between snapshot runs.

sitemapUrls.title: Sitemap URLs (optional)
sitemapUrls.description: Same-site sitemap URL sets or indexes. Bounded to 10 files and depth 2.

followLinks.title: Follow same-site links
followLinks.description: Disabled by default. All discovered page attempts count toward maxPages.

contentCssSelector.title: Content CSS selector
contentCssSelector.description: Optional. Prefer the main documentation content region; no match skips the page unbilled.

excludeCssSelectors.title: Exclude CSS selectors
excludeCssSelectors.description: Optional elements to remove in addition to standard navigation/script cleanup.

includeUnchanged.title: Save unchanged checks
includeUnchanged.description: Successful unchanged checks are saved and billed once unless changedOnly is enabled.

changedOnly.title: Changed pages only
changedOnly.description: Save/bill only NEW or UPDATED pages. Overrides includeUnchanged. Requests still consume resources.

previousSnapshot.title: Previous SNAPSHOT JSON
previousSnapshot.description: Paste the entire SNAPSHOT from a previous run. Version 1, max 5 MiB/2000 pages. No shared cross-run state.

maxPages.title: Maximum page attempts
maxPages.description: Maximum document page attempts for this run, including failed or skipped pages. Sitemap and robots requests are additional. No page removals are inferred from an incomplete crawl.

minTextLength.title: Minimum content characters
minTextLength.description: Minimum cleaned Markdown character count. Smaller pages and detected JavaScript shells are skipped without a paid event and retain their previous baseline.

maxTextChars.title: Maximum page characters
maxTextChars.description: Maximum cleaned Markdown characters per document. Larger documents are skipped without replacing their previous snapshot or emitting chunk tombstones.

chunkSize.title: Chunk character limit
chunkSize.description: Maximum characters per heading-based RAG chunk. Changing this setting can change chunk IDs and produce an UPDATED row even when page Markdown is unchanged.

maxChunksPerPage.title: Maximum chunks per page
maxChunksPerPage.description: Maximum chunks for one complete document. Pages exceeding this limit are skipped without a paid event or baseline advancement.

timeoutSeconds.title: Request timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds for each public HTTP request, including robots and sitemap requests. Failed requests preserve existing snapshot entries.
